variants.name: V1_turn_of_month_long
variants.rule: 1 ES contract ($50/pt), no stop/target, $16.28 per round turn, one position at a time. Price proxy: Oanda index CFD 1-minute bars; 'the HH:MM bar' = the first 1-minute bar with open time >= HH:MM America/Chicago on that CT calendar date; an entry requires that bar to open within 5 minutes of HH:MM (else no trade). Exit = open of the first bar in [15:08, 15:15] CT of the day; if none, on an early-close day (last pre-15:08 bar before 15:00 CT) the open of the last quoted bar before the halt, otherwise the open of the first bar inside the 15:10-17:00 CT break. Flags are set on the bar before the fill bar (protocol.backtest_signals fills at the next bar's open). Trading day = Mon-Fri CT date that is not a US equity-market holiday (NYSE calendar incl. 2007-01-02, 2012-10-29/30) and has cash-session bars. For every month M: leg days = last trading day of M and the first three trading days of M+1. On each leg day enter long at the open of the 17:00 CT bar on the calendar day before the leg day (Sunday 17:00 for a Monday leg) and exit at the 15:08 bar of the leg day; each hold is one trade (4 per month).

variants.name: V3_opex_friday_fade
variants.rule: 1 ES contract ($50/pt), no stop/target, $16.28 per round turn, one position at a time. Price proxy: Oanda index CFD 1-minute bars; 'the HH:MM bar' = the first 1-minute bar with open time >= HH:MM America/Chicago on that CT calendar date; an entry requires that bar to open within 5 minutes of HH:MM (else no trade). On the calendar third Friday of each month (15th-21st): at 14:00 CT compute ratio = (last traded price before 14:00:00 CT, i.e. the close of the 1-minute bar preceding the 14:00 bar) / open(08:30 bar) and enter side = -sign(ratio - 1) at the open of the 14:00 bar (ratio == 1 -> no trade); exit at the 15:08 bar.
